drivingQuestion: Where in the blessing does one say 'who distinguishes between sacred and sacred'?
outcomeNote: The unit opens mid-series: it is the dissenting third answer to היכא אמר לה, asked in chullin.sugya057, and it is set aside by the halakhic note.

segments.he: וְרַב שֵׁשֶׁת בְּרֵיהּ דְּרַב אִידִי אָמַר: אַף בִּפְתִיחָתָהּ, וְלֵית הִלְכְתָא כְּוָותֵיהּ.
segments.en: «And Rav Sheshet, son of Rav Idi, said:» One recites that formula «even at the beginning,» in the body of the blessing, instead of the formula: Who distinguishes between sacred and profane. The Gemara comments: «And the halakha is not in accordance with his» opinion.

moves.cueHe: ורב ששת בריה דרב אידי אמר: אף בפתיחתה
moves.summary: a third answer to the previous unit's question: the formula is said in the body of the blessing too
moves.about: where the formula 'between sacred and sacred' is said — only at the conclusion of the havdala blessing, or in its opening body as well

moves.summary: the halakha does not follow him
moves.about: the halakha is not decided in accordance with his view that the formula is said in the body of the blessing too
